{{Top}}
[[File:Fork-BI.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] using a fork while on board [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]]]]
A '''fork''' was an eating utensil. Many [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] used forks to consume solid foods. They were usually made out of metal, but could be formed out of almost any solid material.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] possessed a survival tool which contained a fork utensil.

Three-pronged forks were not meant to be used when eating [[bruallki]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
